scope: Actual legacy and v2 candidate selection through the same SGLang startup wrapper, both using the corrected delay helper; no shadow confirmation or production change.

source_contract.variant: The same qualified FP8-only descriptor port plus fixture-owned validation callback in every cell; no configured-timer guard or old scoped-cache prototype.

fixture.selection: Prespecified first-layer MLP down projection from the same checkpoint and exact prior 144 input token IDs, before observing any tuning or execution timing. Verify actual dimensions and capture provenance.
fixture.source: Dense BF16 reference forward with actual captured post-nonlinearity activation; benchmark uses static per-tensor FP8 weights/activations through the SGLang linear facade.

source_contract.no_historical_pooling: Prior cohorts provide source/protocol context only; no historical or admission observations enter current estimates.

native_reuse.restoration: Restore exact source archive plus the already-qualified tools and Python-only callback patch; restore entire native cache from the prior private archive. Never rebuild or change native artifact contents.
native_reuse.timestamp_amendment: Archive extraction loses subsecond cache mtimes. Restore eight object mtimes from their unchanged .ninja_deps records. Reconstruct two library filesystem mtimes from build-log timestamps; these are explicitly not claimed original library stat mtimes. Source archive mtimes remain unchanged; every source-owned dependency must precede its recorded build timestamp.
native_reuse.reason: Restore the already-qualified artifacts from durable archives without rebuilding; reuse the independently audited MLP fixture from the completed comparison.
native_reuse.isolation: Fresh process, home and tuner cache per worker; only compiled native artifacts are reused.
native_reuse.failure: Stop before measurement if archive/source/native hashes differ, a dependency timestamp is inconsistent, or actual pinned-container Ninja requires work. No implicit rebuild or load-only fallback.

candidate_contract.use: Candidate descriptors/order/keys only. For v1 the actual enumeration is checked against the same explicit list; no search result or candidate list is altered.

binding.both_arms: Use the identical fixed source and compiled native providers; verify loaded callable, profiler alias, FFI and library identity per process.
binding.ordering_qualification: One fresh patched-only ordering process on the replacement H100/driver before admission. Use unchanged qualified helper to verify default/nondefault Torch streams, conflicting FFI context restoration, actual profiler ordering and changed-input graph replay. Preserve prior two-arm qualification separately; do not pool timings.

arm_intervention.v1: The actual legacy autotune context, SGLang stream/skip/synchronization/load/save behavior, with only the inner autotune_v2 factory replaced by a strict-options null context.
arm_intervention.v2: The actual legacy persistence context plus the original autotune_v2(mode=tune,persistent_cache=False). No measurement policy is supplied.

protocol.cache: Fresh process, container home and isolated empty tuner cache per cold worker. Warm admission processes load an exact copied cache from their own cold admission arm in a fresh process. Reuse only verified compiled native artifacts between arms.
protocol.admission: One independent cold numerical/capture process per arm, then one fresh warm restart per arm. No performance windows. Require same winner/file bytes, real file hits, zero warm profiling and no managed store. Both gates must pass before timing.
protocol.timing: Eight complete paired cold blocks with alternating arm order; each process captures actual cached natural selection and an independent default graph. Twelve eager wall-time pairs and24 queued graph-event pairs. No confirmation, reranking, profiler calls or cache reload after startup.
protocol.serving: Natural serving remains bare outside all tuner contexts. Default control temporarily hides winner/file/managed caches with exact restoration; never writes a control into the selected cache. Independent graph/output allocations even for identical tactics.
protocol.capture_order: Eight blocks cover all eight combinations of first arm, natural/default capture order and eager/graph measurement order. Each paired arm uses identical capture/mode/within-process orders.
protocol.measurement_policy: Unspecified in both arms; actual operation uses the existing non-graph hot-L2 event profiler.
protocol.ordering: Separate fresh process with exact corrected helper/native providers. All ordering/FFI restoration/profiler/numerical graph checks must pass and dependency witnesses must match subsequent workers. Excluded from selection/performance estimates.

analysis.unit: Eight complete paired cold blocks. Within-process windows are dependent repetitions. Admission and warm verification do not enter performance estimates.
analysis.primary: Each process: median paired log(natural/default) over24 graph windows, retaining independently measured ratios even when natural is default. Pair v2 minus v1 log ratios, then exponentiate the mean across8 blocks.
secondary: Same calculation for eager synchronized wall time over12 pairs; GPU-event eager time is contextual.
Absolute natural/default graph timings and v2/v1 absolute timings, plus capture/mode/launch-position strata.
Choice-only normalized graph score assigns ratio1 to a selected default; report separately from measured primary.
All selected descriptors, shared explicit candidate/order/key agreement, first-pass candidate timings and ranks; do not infer v1 by dropping -1 from a v2 run.
Cold startup host duration and profile count as separate costs. No runtime overhead claim from startup cost.
Fresh warm cache winner and zero profiling as correctness/reuse evidence only.

uncertainty.unit: Resample whole paired blocks with shared indices across metrics.

analysis.interpretation: If both arms choose identical descriptors/native signatures, report that directly; measured timing differences alone do not demonstrate improved candidate selection. Preserve neutral/adverse outcomes. No equivalence/safety/universal claim.
analysis.no_pooling: No prior corrected-helper, historical, admission or warm result enters the new timing estimates.

stopping.integrity: Stop and preserve all attempted data on source/native/cache/numerical/protocol failure. Any amendment gets a new explicit source identity and attempt; no silent retry.
stopping.performance: Complete8paired blocks regardless of timing sign. No adaptive sample expansion, candidate margin or exclusions.
stopping.resource: Prepare exact pinned image and freeze/push source before one exclusive30-minute H100 experiment allocation. Re-admit recorded GPU/driver/image/native identities; stop on mismatch. Release after exact local archive verification; GPU never waits for publication.
stopping.storage: Preserve exact private archives/receipts in durable local /Users/lnau/flashinfer-autotune-evidence outside SGLang; remote home is nearly full. Do not delete prior evidence to make room.

limits: One retained first-layer MLP projection, physical GPU and contiguous time window; no full-model serving throughput or quantized model-quality claim.

Instrumented ordinary SGLang startup/serving APIs, including numerical and descriptor-acceptance guards before capture. No shadow confirmation; this is not byte-identical uninstrumented startup history.
Profiling uses original synthetic dynamic activations; serving uses captured real-model activations plus actual quantization.
Fixed source plus recorded FP8 descriptor/benchmark validation overlays and corrected delay wrapper; not qualification of an unrelated nightly or stock release.
Graph capture/allocation/history remain part of the protocol; independently measured identical choices may still differ. No candidate-selection improvement claim from that difference.
Warm persistence is qualified on the two independent admission winners; it does not cover every timing winner or prove default persistence if neither admission selected -1.
V1 persistence remains unchanged. Production measurement policy, managed-store migration, scoped-cache adoption, TP/EP, MegaMoE and CI are outside this checkpoint.

The original host was unavailable. This cohort uses a replacement H100NVL and newer driver580.196.07, qualified before measurement. It does not isolate driver or physical-host effects relative to historical cohorts.
